limitations: Conference poster only; no per-animal data, raw laboratory records, or peer-reviewed full-cohort paper were used in this candidate intake.

The study model selects 29 lambs supported for at least six days. Its FLI-start denominator and the biochemical endpoint/paired n are not reported; do not assign n=29 to the plotted biochemical summaries.
Biochemical center values and bracketed ranges are transcribed as displayed. The poster does not define the bracket statistic, so these ranges are not labeled as IQR, SD, or confidence intervals.

The growth panel labels n=5 and n=24 by gestational-age group and reports p=0.186 for the displayed group comparison. Panel 3 separately reports adjusted model associations; these displays are retained as separate analyses, not recalculated or forced into agreement.

The poster reports bilirubin and BUN increases and albumin decrease by days 6-7 while AST and ALT show no significant change; its interpretation is limited to these source-reported biochemical results and does not establish comprehensive organ health or successful gestation.

No post-support transition or developmental follow-up is reported here. This cohort has no public unit-level link to the four EP09.22 transition cases, the 2023-24 abstract cohort, Gaia, or company follow-up claims.
The candidate is not a human support specification and does not establish continuity from embryo culture to fetal support.
